source.checklist_title: Ledgerly remaining work in priority order
source.scope: All 18 agreed commercial product priorities; accounting, tax and payroll calculations are built in-house. Direct HMRC and necessary service interfaces remain permitted.
source.catalogue_policy: The original 92 bullet packages remain pending. Additional contract/external/narrow-trial tasks expose prerequisites and actual integrated evidence; six narrow trial completions do not complete broad source packages. Workers are reusable and have no permanent specialist ownership. Only exact paths and directory prefixes form file leases; future module paths are proposed work areas, not claims of existing functionality.

tasks.title: Review shared financial correction and credit interfaces
tasks.description: Coordinator review of the smallest money/event/credit-capacity contracts needed by the approved accounting backlog; no new owner approval cycle.
acceptance: Write exact examples for fully paid credits, unapplied excess and corrected originals using stable source/journal identities.
Document historical cutoffs, atomicity, precision and tenant/permission invariants before dependent financial code changes.

tasks.title: Activate tested corrections safely
tasks.description: Activate tested corrections safely. Rehearse the amendment/head-table migration on a representative existing-data copy; verify backup, rollback and history before enabling corrections in the demo or customer environments. They are currently disabled in the reviewed demo. This task prepares and rehearses the migration only; applying it to an existing demo/customer environment is the separate owner-required P01-80 action.
acceptance: On an explicitly disposable representative database copy, install the amendment overlay and reconcile before/after source, journal and history fingerprints.
Prove complete absence, partial schema and failed-upgrade cases fail safely; archive restore and rollback evidence without writing the existing demo or customer database.

tasks.title: Allow credits after full payment
tasks.description: Allow credits after full payment. Complete the missing workflow for a fully paid bill or invoice to receive a valid credit and create a refundable or reusable balance. Example: a £120 paid bill must be able to receive a £12 supplier credit.
acceptance: A synthetic fully paid GBP120 bill can receive a valid GBP12 supplier credit, retaining the payment and producing a reusable/refundable balance.
Customer-credit counterpart, duplicate requests, concurrency and cumulative-credit caps preserve balanced journals, original evidence and company permissions.

tasks.title: Finish excess-credit and discount handling
tasks.description: Finish excess-credit and discount handling. Support unapplied balances, later allocation and refunds with clear cumulative limits; define conditional discounts. Do not cap a genuine credit solely by the remaining cash amount due.
acceptance: Unapplied excess credit can be allocated later or refunded with exact signed balance and cumulative-cap reconciliation.
Conditional and later-discount examples are reviewed; retries, partial settlement and reversals cannot double-allocate or rewrite earlier history.

tasks.title: Complete correction interactions
tasks.description: Complete correction interactions. Use one historical document-event calculation for balances, credit limits, reports, VAT and return claims. Then safely support credits and claims against corrected originals; retain the current blocks until those cases are proven.
acceptance: The same signed event projection drives settlement, report/VAT totals, credit capacity and return eligibility for corrected originals.
Synthetic correction followed by credit/claim and historical-cutoff tests pass before existing safety blocks are removed; concurrent changes fail atomically.

tasks.title: Qualify difficult money cases
tasks.description: Qualify difficult money cases. Obtain independent accounting review of partial payments, mixed VAT, inclusive/exclusive amounts, rounding, linked discounts, overpayments and concurrent actions. Prove balanced journals and unchanged historical reports at earlier dates.
acceptance: Independently reviewed examples cover partial payments, mixed VAT, inclusive/exclusive pricing, rounding, discounts and overpayments.
Every supported case has balanced journals, matching control balances, immutable evidence and unchanged prior-cutoff results, including rollback and concurrency tests.

tasks.title: Apply reviewed correction migration to an authorised existing environment
tasks.description: Execute the concrete reviewed migration only after the owner names the existing demo/customer target and approves this action; never infer authority from coding approval.
acceptance: Record explicit target-specific authority and verified backup immediately before the existing-data migration.
Reconcile source/history after migration and retain rollback/recovery evidence; abort on unapproved target or partial schema.

tasks.title: Review every remaining legacy route and action for explicit role/capability checks
tasks.description: Review every remaining legacy route and action for explicit role/capability checks; test cross-company reads, writes, downloads and exports, inactive membership and stale company context.
acceptance: Inventory every remaining route/action and map it to explicit server capability checks; inactive members and viewers are rejected where appropriate.
Cross-company read/write/download/export and delayed old-company response tests pass without adding an authentication bypass.

tasks.title: Complete invitations, removal, role changes and external identity reconciliation
tasks.description: Complete invitations, removal, role changes and external identity reconciliation. Recheck permissions on every consequential action; preserve the implemented last-owner protection.
acceptance: Invites, role changes and removal are exercised against signed synthetic identity events, including duplicate and out-of-order delivery.
Consequential actions recheck current membership; stale identity state cannot regain access or remove the final active owner.

tasks.title: Harden production sessions, secrets, transport/security headers, rate limits, upload limits and dependencies
tasks.description: Harden production sessions, secrets, transport/security headers, rate limits, upload limits and dependencies; redact sensitive data from logs and error responses. The completed outer error boundary P02-90 is one slice only; session, header, rate-limit and dependency hardening remain open. Lockfile changes require coordinator review, not a new owner approval.
acceptance: Production session/header/rate/input policies are explicit and exercised with malformed, oversized and repeated requests without breaking approved Clerk/origin flows.
Secret/dependency checks pass and HTTP/log tests prove request bodies, tokens, provider responses and arbitrary exception text are redacted.

tasks.title: Separate payroll and personal tax access from ordinary bookkeeping roles
tasks.description: Separate payroll and personal tax access from ordinary bookkeeping roles; define who may see pay, identifiers and bank details, approve a run, or file a return. Audit access and changes.
acceptance: Define and test separate rights for bookkeeping, payroll records, payroll approval, personal tax preparation and submission.
Negative tests prevent unauthorised salary/identifier/bank-data reads and exports, while recording allowed reads and consequential changes with the correct actor/company.

tasks.title: Fixed JSON boundary for unhandled application errors
tasks.description: Completed bounded slice integrated in eb5af9f, with runner registration 7268db7: final Express error boundary returns safe fixed errors for parser/origin/unexpected failures. Broader hardening remains P02-03.
acceptance: Integrated HTTP tests cover malformed/oversized body, denied origin and unknown error cases with safe statuses and fixed JSON.
Unexpected messages/stacks/body/credentials do not reach clients or unsafe logs; existing handled financial responses and Clerk protections remain intact.

tasks.title: Review additive persistence and migration interfaces
tasks.description: Coordinator reviews schema versions, transaction boundaries and migration/recovery contracts before new persistence modules depend on them.
acceptance: Define reviewed additive tables, version guards and shared operation/job/filing identifiers without applying them to existing databases.
Migration tests use a new disposable database, preserve restricted runtime roles and prove partial schemas fail safely.

tasks.title: Persist operation identities and outcomes on the server for payments, corrections, capture conversion, payroll and filing
tasks.description: Persist operation identities and outcomes on the server for payments, corrections, capture conversion, payroll and filing. Reload, re-login, company switch and retry must resolve the same attempt without duplicate effects.
acceptance: Server-persisted actor/company operation identity resolves the same result after reload, re-login, company switch, timeout and duplicate delivery.
Transactions write outcome and accounting effects atomically; a removed member cannot recover another company result and no financial payload/token is placed in browser storage.

tasks.title: Replace memory-only job/reference state with durable jobs, an outbox and a scheduler
tasks.description: Replace memory-only job/reference state with durable jobs, an outbox and a scheduler. Add leases, bounded retries, cancellation and recovery after worker restarts.
acceptance: Persistent jobs/outbox retain queued and in-flight work across process restart and support bounded retry, cancellation and lease expiry.
Duplicate delivery and stale worker completion have at most one committed effect; failed jobs retain source evidence and expose safe retry diagnostics.

tasks.title: Create a reviewed migration pipeline for existing businesses, with version checks and rehearsal
tasks.description: Create a reviewed migration pipeline for existing businesses, with version checks and rehearsal. Prove failed migrations and partial schemas stop safely; do not rely on startup to modify customer data.
acceptance: Versioned migrations rehearse against fresh and representative existing-data disposable copies; startup never silently upgrades customer schemas.
Partial/failed migration, rollback/forward-fix and backup-restore cases produce machine-readable evidence and stop deployment on incompatible schema versions.

tasks.title: Establish off-site backup, encryption and restore ownership now
tasks.description: Establish off-site backup, encryption and restore ownership now; prove restoration to a new environment including roles, attachments, jobs and audit evidence. Set measurable recovery time and data-loss targets. External backup-account provisioning or access grants require P03-80; local implementation and disposable rehearsals are approved.
acceptance: Define recovery-time and recovery-point targets plus backup encryption/key/retention ownership; produce an encrypted synthetic backup with original attachments and audit.
Restore a new disposable environment including database roles and job/source records, compare fingerprints and record measured recovery time; no existing environment is overwritten.

tasks.title: Authorise external off-site backup destination
tasks.description: Obtain action-specific authority before connecting/provisioning off-site backup storage or granting access; the approved rehearsal uses synthetic data.
acceptance: Owner approves destination, cost/access scope, encryption/key ownership and retention for the concrete backup setup.
Record the connection/access outcome without exposing credentials and confirm synthetic-data-only rehearsal boundaries.

tasks.title: Freeze the supported entities, income types, VAT schemes, employments and tax years in a case register
tasks.description: Freeze the supported entities, income types, VAT schemes, employments and tax years in a case register. Map every supported case to a rule, expected result, test and owner; reject unsupported cases visibly.
acceptance: Publish a machine-readable entity, income, scheme, employment and tax-year matrix with supported/unsupported status, official rule provenance and required input/output examples.
Every promised supported case has acceptance coverage; unknown cases fail explicitly and the register neither purchases an engine nor reduces the agreed product scope.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic calculations with explicit decimal precision and statutory rounding
tasks.description: Implement deterministic calculations with explicit decimal precision and statutory rounding. Version effective dates, thresholds, allowances, schemas and calculation steps; preserve prior-year replay and explain every result.
acceptance: Implement shared deterministic amount/rounding/effective-date primitives with explicit precision and immutable rule-version identifiers.
Official boundary fixtures and prior-year replay reproduce the same inputs, intermediate steps and outputs; later rule changes never rewrite old calculations.

tasks.title: Create official-example and accountant-reviewed fixture packs before implementing rules
tasks.description: Create official-example and accountant-reviewed fixture packs before implementing rules. Cover boundaries, losses, refunds, corrections and year changes; independently verify expected results rather than deriving them from our own code.
acceptance: Expected results come from pinned official examples or independently reviewed calculations, with source dates and tax-year provenance.
Fixture coverage includes thresholds, negative/refund cases, losses, corrections and year transitions; expected outputs are not generated solely by the implementation under test.

tasks.title: Build shared filing records: immutable reviewed payload, authorisation, submission identity, status, receipt and amendment lineage
tasks.description: Build shared filing records: immutable reviewed payload, authorisation, submission identity, status, receipt and amendment lineage. Unknown responses must trigger status recovery, not blind resubmission.
acceptance: Reviewed payloads, authority, submission identity, receipt/status and amendment lineage are immutable and company-scoped.
Timeout/retry/duplicate/out-of-order response tests recover the original operation and require verified provider evidence before displaying accepted/submitted success.

tasks.title: Assign ongoing ownership of tax-year updates and emergency rule fixes
tasks.description: Assign ongoing ownership of tax-year updates and emergency rule fixes. Confirm HMRC production access and intended launch tax year early: its MTD guide currently says new 2026-27 quarterly-update product applications are closed. Check the next route directly. Read-only requirements research and maintenance assignments are approved. Credentials, applications that bind the business and live connections are handled by P08-80.
acceptance: Assign tax-year/rule-update responsibility, review lead times and an emergency-fix protocol; identify the actual intended launch years and API versions.
Record current official HMRC production-access criteria and the route available for new MTD products, with unresolved external dependencies visible before date commitments.

tasks.title: Complete audited correction/reversal routes for posted credit documents, plus versioned changes to allowed metadata such as notes, reference and due date
tasks.description: Complete audited correction/reversal routes for posted credit documents, plus versioned changes to allowed metadata such as notes, reference and due date. Keep original financial evidence immutable.
acceptance: Posted credit corrections/reversals and permitted metadata edits retain original records, actor, reason and version history.
Corrected credits reconcile settlements and reports at old/new cutoffs; forbidden field edits and stale reviews are rejected atomically.

tasks.title: Finish repeated return cycles, receipt corrections, cancellations and reopening rules in awaiting credits
tasks.description: Finish repeated return cycles, receipt corrections, cancellations and reopening rules in awaiting credits. Distinguish expected, received, allocated and refunded amounts throughout.
acceptance: Repeated return cycles, cancellation/reopening and receipt corrections preserve distinct expected, received, allocated and refunded balances.
Partial quantities, duplicate receipt claims, corrected originals and concurrent changes cannot exceed remaining capacity or fabricate a received credit.

tasks.title: Complete real month-end and year-end workflows: journals and adjustments, control-account reconciliation, period close/reopen, lock dates and retained earnings
tasks.description: Complete real month-end and year-end workflows: journals and adjustments, control-account reconciliation, period close/reopen, lock dates and retained earnings. Preserve existing closed-period guards.
acceptance: A synthetic month/year closes after control-account checks, carries retained earnings correctly and can reopen only through a reviewed audited action.
Locked dates reject new/changed postings; close/reopen races and retries retain a balanced ledger and historical snapshots.

tasks.title: Reconcile the general ledger, trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, aged balances, statements and VAT after every supported correction/payment/credit combination
tasks.description: Reconcile the general ledger, trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, aged balances, statements and VAT after every supported correction/payment/credit combination; finish drilldowns and consistent exports.
acceptance: Trial balance, general ledger, P&L, balance sheet, ageing, statements and VAT reconcile over the supported payment/credit/correction matrix.
Report-to-document-to-journal navigation and exported exact amounts retain company and period context; formula-like source text is neutralised.

tasks.title: Resolve remaining contact/account management edge cases: duplicate or archived parties, changed details, account mapping, tax status and historical documents
tasks.description: Resolve remaining contact/account management edge cases: duplicate or archived parties, changed details, account mapping, tax status and historical documents. Preserve usable search and readable error recovery.
acceptance: Archived/duplicate-name parties, changed details, account mappings and tax-status changes are resolved using stable identifiers and readable validations.
Historical documents retain their original evidence and all edits/search/results remain company-scoped with stale-response tests.

tasks.title: Freeze native bank transaction and import interfaces
tasks.description: Define stable source identities and protected payment/allocation contracts for banking and migration while preserving current settlement guards.
acceptance: Specify exact-money/date/duplicate identity and review contracts for splits, fees, reversal and repeated statements.
Prove in fixtures that bank status alone cannot change a document balance and unknown outcomes recover using the original command identity.

tasks.title: Build native bank statement import and matching on the protected payment/allocation path
tasks.description: Build native bank statement import and matching on the protected payment/allocation path. Finish duplicate detection, splits, partial matches, fees, unmatched items, undo and reconciled-period behaviour. The existing exact-CSV preview slice P06-90 does not complete native persistence or matching.
acceptance: Native statement identity and reviewed import/matching support splits, partial allocations, fees, unmatched items and undo on protected payment commands.
Repeated files/events and concurrent matches have one effect; ambiguous identical rows require reviewed identity, and no legacy write changes a document balance.

tasks.title: Prove imported bank balance, reconciliation and ledger cash agree
tasks.description: Prove imported bank balance, reconciliation and ledger cash agree; handle repeated imports and late transactions without double posting. Replace blocked legacy matching paths only after the native path is qualified.
acceptance: Statement opening/closing balance, native bank transactions, settlements and ledger cash reconcile on a fixed synthetic import pack.
Late transactions, repeated imports, reversals and reconciled-period restrictions behave consistently before blocked legacy matching UI is replaced.

tasks.title: Deliver reviewed imports from Xero/QuickBooks exports and standard files: contacts, accounts, opening balances and outstanding items
tasks.description: Deliver reviewed imports from Xero/QuickBooks exports and standard files: contacts, accounts, opening balances and outstanding items. Define supported history, attachments and mappings rather than silently dropping data.
acceptance: Preview supported Xero/QuickBooks/standard exports with explicit contact/account/opening-balance/outstanding-item mappings and documented history/attachment limits.
Unknown columns, tax treatments, currencies and duplicate identifiers surface before commit; no source row or attachment is silently dropped.

tasks.title: Provide preview, validation, resumable import, duplicate prevention and a safe recovery route
tasks.description: Provide preview, validation, resumable import, duplicate prevention and a safe recovery route. Test opening debtors/creditors, tax balances and bank balances against a signed migration reconciliation.
acceptance: An interrupted migration resumes without duplicate parties, balances or documents and provides a safe reviewed rollback/recovery route.
Signed reconciliation confirms opening debtors, creditors, tax controls and bank balances against the imported evidence before use.

tasks.title: Qualify complete customer data export and attachments so a business can leave or switch accountant without losing records
tasks.description: Qualify complete customer data export and attachments so a business can leave or switch accountant without losing records; retain stable references and usable formats.
acceptance: Export all supported customer accounting records, stable references and original attachments in documented portable formats with count/hash checks.
Cross-company export/download attempts fail; interrupted exports recover without exposing temporary URLs or omitting evidence.

tasks.title: Exact bank CSV validation and reviewed duplicate warnings
tasks.description: Completed bounded slice integrated in 08c776d and clarified in 4d9aa6c: exact-pence/date/CSV checks, mapping/row errors, scoped async handling and duplicate-candidate warnings. Native persistence/matching remains P06-01.
acceptance: Integrated tests reject malformed CSV, invalid/ambiguous dates, invalid pennies, duplicate mappings and unsafe/stale import scope.
Duplicate warning coverage is honestly bounded; no ledger settlement path or production data changed.

tasks.title: Test a genuinely empty business from signup through company/tax setup, first contact, first bill/invoice, review and posting
tasks.description: Test a genuinely empty business from signup through company/tax setup, first contact, first bill/invoice, review and posting. The replacement setup flow exists; this complete customer journey still needs qualification.
acceptance: A fresh synthetic company completes signup/setup, contact creation, first bill/invoice, review and posting without inherited demo setup.
Record the exact journey and errors; a saved draft never implies posted/paid/filed status and viewers cannot complete restricted steps.

tasks.title: Save setup progress and optional help preferences
tasks.description: Save setup progress and optional help preferences; make the next useful action clear without forcing experienced users through a wizard. Explain draft, posted, paid, credited and filed states consistently. P07-90 completed only the boolean guidance preference; saved readiness, next-task clarity and consistent cross-product states remain to qualify.
acceptance: Reload and resume identify saved setup and the next real task without forcing an expert through a wizard; optional help remains account/company scoped.
Draft, posted, paid, credited and filed states use consistent truthful labels across setup and first-task journeys; no financial payload is stored in browser preferences.

tasks.title: Preserve compact tables, familiar accounting terms, search, filters, detailed money/VAT information and direct expert tools
tasks.description: Preserve compact tables, familiar accounting terms, search, filters, detailed money/VAT information and direct expert tools. Finish keyboard and useful bulk actions where appropriate.
acceptance: Representative daily tasks retain compact tables, searchable/filterable records, visible VAT/payment detail and direct expert access.
Keyboard and approved bulk actions preserve selection, confirmation and company permissions; existing routes and data remain reachable.

tasks.title: Remove misleading customer-facing placeholders and clearly label unavailable functions
tasks.description: Remove misleading customer-facing placeholders and clearly label unavailable functions; preserve the existing feature inventory, direct links and saved dashboard behaviour.
acceptance: Compare every current route and saved dashboard capability against the feature inventory and preserve access to implemented functions.
Unavailable/placeholder services are labelled accurately, with no false connected/filed/automated claims and no accidental feature deletion.

tasks.title: Run two observed usability rounds with novices and experienced accounting users
tasks.description: Run two observed usability rounds with novices and experienced accounting users. Measure completion, manual re-entry, errors and help requests on the same tasks; fix the largest obstacles before calling the interface ready. Prepare the task pack internally; participant invitations or messages are separate owner-authorised actions when requested.
acceptance: Observe two rounds containing novice and experienced users on the same tasks; capture completion, re-entry, errors, help requests and elapsed time.
Resolve the largest observed obstacles and compare subsequent results against the same baseline; do not describe unobserved journeys as accepted.

tasks.title: Remember optional setup guidance per account and company
tasks.description: Completed bounded slice integrated in fd3fa77: boolean-only guidance preference survives reload with account/company scoping and safe storage failures. Broader setup/next-action work remains P07-02.
acceptance: Integrated tests separate signed-in user/company preferences and recover defaults from corrupt or unavailable storage.
Only the guidance boolean is persisted; financial records and tokens are not stored and existing server-derived readiness is preserved.

tasks.title: Implement a complete nine-box return model and supported transactions for boxes 2, 3, 8 and 9
tasks.description: Implement a complete nine-box return model and supported transactions for boxes 2, 3, 8 and 9. Keep unsupported amounts blocked, rather than substituting zero. Link each figure to source transactions and adjustments.
acceptance: Complete nine-box results for approved supported transaction types with source/adjustment traceability and exact rule-version evidence.
Unsupported schemes/transactions continue to block preparation with unknown values rather than invented zeroes; official examples and correction reconciliation pass.

tasks.title: Approve scheme coverage: standard invoice accounting, and explicit decisions on cash accounting, flat rate, partial exemption, reverse charge and imports
tasks.description: Approve scheme coverage: standard invoice accounting, and explicit decisions on cash accounting, flat rate, partial exemption, reverse charge and imports. Build and qualify each scheme promised at launch; expose exclusions before setup.
acceptance: Record explicit standard/cash/flat-rate/partial-exemption/reverse-charge/import coverage and official rules for each launch-promised case.
Implement and independently qualify every supported scheme, while showing unsupported exclusions before setup and preserving past rule-version results.

tasks.title: Finish VAT period locking, late entries, adjustments and correction routes
tasks.description: Finish VAT period locking, late entries, adjustments and correction routes; reconcile returns to the ledger and preserve the exact submitted snapshot.
acceptance: Late entries, period locks, adjustments and amended versions reconcile to the ledger and preserve the exact submitted snapshot.
Locked/submitted payloads cannot be rewritten; duplicate corrections and concurrent period edits are rejected or safely replayed with audit.

tasks.title: Implement direct HMRC authorisation, obligations, submission, liabilities/payment visibility where required, verified receipts and timeout recovery
tasks.description: Implement direct HMRC authorisation, obligations, submission, liabilities/payment visibility where required, verified receipts and timeout recovery. Complete fraud-prevention headers, sandbox tests and production-access requirements.
acceptance: Implement direct HMRC OAuth/obligation/return/status interfaces and required fraud headers using fixtures and authorised sandbox credentials only.
Accepted, rejected, expired-token, timeout and repeated-submit cases preserve authority and verified receipts; production connection remains behind P08-80.

tasks.title: Provide a clear review/sign-off journey with warnings, submission evidence and amendment guidance
tasks.description: Provide a clear review/sign-off journey with warnings, submission evidence and amendment guidance; never equate an internal status with an HMRC-accepted return.
acceptance: Customer review exposes return figures, source evidence, blockers, authority and exact submission package before explicit sign-off.
Receipt/status/amendment views distinguish internal preparation, unknown submission and HMRC acceptance; unauthorised users cannot file.

tasks.title: Authorise required HMRC accounts and production credentials
tasks.description: Prepare and obtain authority for account registration, credentials or business-binding HMRC applications for the approved VAT/Income Tax/Corporation Tax/RTI interfaces. This does not authorise filing an actual tax return.
acceptance: Owner approves each concrete application/account, tax year, scope and credential action after the access requirements are verified.
Credentials are stored with restricted access; no actual return is submitted, tax payment made or unverified filing success recorded.

tasks.title: Filtered VAT source evidence CSV
tasks.description: Completed bounded slice integrated in 4ec0b84: filtered CSV retains exact signed source/correction evidence, company/period/filter context and explicit non-return labels. Complete VAT calculation/filing remains P08-01 through P08-05.
acceptance: Integrated tests prove filter/export parity, correction signs, huge-money precision, formula-neutralisation and company/period reset.
Unsupported boxes stay unknown and no-VAT/empty/invalid contexts do not fabricate figures; full-workings export remains available.

tasks.title: Create employer and employee records, payroll IDs, pay schedules, employment dates, tax/NI settings and prior year-to-date values
tasks.description: Create employer and employee records, payroll IDs, pay schedules, employment dates, tax/NI settings and prior year-to-date values. Qualify migration into a live tax year and starter/leaver/rejoiner cases.
acceptance: Employer/employee records capture stable payroll IDs, schedules, tax/NI settings, employment dates and verified prior YTD values.
Mid-year migration, starters/leavers/rejoiners and effective changes retain history and prevent cross-role/company access or duplicate employment identity.

tasks.title: Implement gross pay: salary, hours, overtime, bonuses, arrears, holiday/absence inputs, adjustments and supported benefits
tasks.description: Implement gross pay: salary, hours, overtime, bonuses, arrears, holiday/absence inputs, adjustments and supported benefits. Define pay-period cutoffs and effective-dated changes.
acceptance: Salary/hourly/overtime/bonus/arrears/absence/benefit fixtures produce reviewed exact gross components for supported schedules.
Cutoffs and effective-dated changes reject incomplete/unsupported input and preserve previous periods without silently rounding or altering approved pay.

tasks.title: Implement PAYE with official routines: cumulative and non-cumulative bases, relevant tax-code forms, Scottish/Welsh treatment, code changes, irregular pay and refunds
tasks.description: Implement PAYE with official routines: cumulative and non-cumulative bases, relevant tax-code forms, Scottish/Welsh treatment, code changes, irregular pay and refunds. Retain a reproducible calculation breakdown.
acceptance: Official PAYE cases cover cumulative/non-cumulative bases, supported tax-code forms, Scottish/Welsh treatment, irregular pay and refunds.
Each result retains rule-year/version and reproducible calculation steps; code changes and period/year boundaries reproduce independently reviewed outputs.

tasks.title: Implement employee/employer National Insurance, relevant categories and director methods
tasks.description: Implement employee/employer National Insurance, relevant categories and director methods; handle thresholds, age/status changes and period boundaries with independent fixtures.
acceptance: Employee/employer NI categories and director methods match independently checked official examples for supported periods.
Threshold, age/status transition, irregular-pay and year-boundary fixtures preserve exact rounding and explain every category/method used.

tasks.title: Implement student/postgraduate loans, statutory payments and recoveries, supported deductions and salary sacrifice
tasks.description: Implement student/postgraduate loans, statutory payments and recoveries, supported deductions and salary sacrifice. Test eligibility, limits, interactions, negative net pay and effective dates.
acceptance: Supported student/postgraduate loans, statutory pay/recovery, deductions and salary-sacrifice cases match reviewed eligibility/limit/effective-date examples.
Interaction, negative-net and correction tests reject unsupported combinations explicitly and preserve prior period YTD evidence.

tasks.title: Build pension assessment and calculations, enrolment/postponement/opt-out/re-enrolment workflows, contribution records and scheme-specific outputs
tasks.description: Build pension assessment and calculations, enrolment/postponement/opt-out/re-enrolment workflows, contribution records and scheme-specific outputs. Validate applicable pension duties and supported schemes with a specialist.
acceptance: Assessment, contribution, postponement, opt-out and re-enrolment cases match independently validated supported scheme rules.
Versioned scheme outputs reconcile contributions to employee/employer liabilities; no real enrolment or provider connection occurs without P09-80 approval.

tasks.title: Deliver preview, approval, finalisation, payroll locking and audited corrections
tasks.description: Deliver preview, approval, finalisation, payroll locking and audited corrections. Reconcile employee net pay, employer costs, deductions, pension liabilities and payroll journals without duplicate posting.
acceptance: Preview-to-approval-to-finalisation reconciles gross/net pay, employer costs, deductions, pensions and canonical journals for the same immutable run.
Locking, correction, concurrent approval and repeated delivery have at most one financial effect and retain the original run plus signed amendments.

tasks.title: Produce secure payslips, employer reports, P45/P60 outputs, payment files and year-end processing
tasks.description: Produce secure payslips, employer reports, P45/P60 outputs, payment files and year-end processing. Test access separation, delivery, totals and opening values for the next tax year.
acceptance: Payslip, employer report, P45/P60 and payment-file fixtures agree with finalised runs and correctly seed the next tax year.
Authorisation, secure download/delivery preparation and correction-version tests prevent salary leakage and never imply payment or external delivery from file generation.

tasks.title: Build direct RTI FPS/EPS preparation, validation, transmission, receipts and rejection recovery, plus relevant HMRC notices
tasks.description: Build direct RTI FPS/EPS preparation, validation, transmission, receipts and rejection recovery, plus relevant HMRC notices. Verify correction and late-reporting journeys; never mark an unverified request as filed.
acceptance: FPS/EPS payloads and relevant notice handling validate against the correct official tax-year schemas and sandbox/local-test examples.
Rejection, late-reporting, correction, duplicate and unknown-response tests preserve submission identity and require verified evidence before filed status.

tasks.title: Run complete pay cycles and year rollover against official and independently checked expected results
tasks.description: Run complete pay cycles and year rollover against official and independently checked expected results. Plan for the launch year: 2027-28 RTI specifications are already listed by HMRC.
acceptance: Complete supported pay cycles, amendments, leavers and year rollover against pinned official and independently reviewed expected results.
Record exact engine/rule/schema versions for launch years, including current availability of 2027-28 RTI specifications; reconcile YTD, journals, outputs and receipts.

tasks.title: Authorise pension provider or scheme connection
tasks.description: Connect a necessary pension submission interface only after the owner approves the concrete scheme/account and scope; Ledgerly retains its in-house calculations.
acceptance: Record scheme/account/scope authority and verify minimum permissions without purchasing a tax/payroll calculation engine.
Connection/revocation evidence excludes secrets and does not enrol employees or transmit live contributions without their separate required authority.

tasks.title: Build the taxpayer/income case model and map accounting records to tax categories
tasks.description: Build the taxpayer/income case model and map accounting records to tax categories. Define support for sole trade, property and other promised income sources, residency, multiple businesses and tax-year boundaries.
acceptance: Supported taxpayer, residency, trade/property/other income and multiple-business cases have explicit inputs, ledger mappings and period boundaries.
Unsupported income/residency combinations fail before calculations and personal records remain separate from company bookkeeping access.

tasks.title: Implement our own taxable-profit and liability calculations for the agreed cases: disallowable expenses, allowances, losses, reliefs, relevant National Insurance, other income interactions and payments on account
tasks.description: Implement our own taxable-profit and liability calculations for the agreed cases: disallowable expenses, allowances, losses, reliefs, relevant National Insurance, other income interactions and payments on account.
acceptance: Our own taxable-profit/liability engine matches reviewed allowances, disallowable costs, losses, reliefs, relevant NI and payments-on-account examples.
Boundary, cross-income, year-change and correction cases retain calculation steps/rule versions and reject unqualified combinations.

tasks.title: Separate bookkeeping profit, tax adjustments and personal tax
tasks.description: Separate bookkeeping profit, tax adjustments and personal tax. Show how each result was calculated, retain evidence, and make unsupported income/relief combinations an explicit blocker.
acceptance: The review separates bookkeeping profit, tax adjustments and personal liability with source evidence and an explainable calculation breakdown.
Unsupported relief/income combinations visibly block finalisation and changed source records invalidate stale review rather than silently rewriting approved results.

tasks.title: Maintain digital records and build obligation tracking, quarterly updates, annual adjustments, review, finalisation and amendment journeys through direct HMRC APIs, with correct taxpayer/agent authority
tasks.description: Maintain digital records and build obligation tracking, quarterly updates, annual adjustments, review, finalisation and amendment journeys through direct HMRC APIs, with correct taxpayer/agent authority.

Sandbox fixtures cover business/period mismatches, revoked consent, duplicate submissions and immutable status/receipt history without live filing.

tasks.title: Reconcile the local engine with HMRC-returned calculations and statuses
tasks.description: Reconcile the local engine with HMRC-returned calculations and statuses. Investigate discrepancies before finalisation; do not imply an internal estimate replaces the official filing flow.

tasks.title: Complete required headers, tests and production approval for the intended launch tax year

The production-access evidence explicitly resolves the relevant application window and pending external steps; credential/application actions remain P08-80.

tasks.title: Qualify complete supported returns across year changes, non-aligned periods, losses, cessation and corrected bookkeeping
tasks.description: Qualify complete supported returns across year changes, non-aligned periods, losses, cessation and corrected bookkeeping; include rejected/unknown submissions and immutable receipt history.
acceptance: Supported complete returns cover losses, cessation, non-aligned periods, corrected accounting and tax-year changes against independently reviewed results.
Rejected/unknown submissions and amendments retain immutable receipts, authority and source reconciliation before release qualification.

tasks.title: Build the company and accounting-period model, accounting-to-tax reconciliation and our own taxable-profit calculation
tasks.description: Build the company and accounting-period model, accounting-to-tax reconciliation and our own taxable-profit calculation. Cover supported disallowable costs, capital allowances, losses and reliefs.
acceptance: Company/period models reconcile bookkeeping profit to our own taxable-profit calculation for approved costs, allowances, losses and reliefs.
Unsupported company/period cases block computation and adjustments preserve source evidence, exact amounts and historical rule versions.

tasks.title: Implement relevant rates, marginal relief, associated-company effects and period apportionment
tasks.description: Implement relevant rates, marginal relief, associated-company effects and period apportionment. Handle short/long accounting periods and tax-year changes with versioned rules and independently verified examples.
acceptance: Reviewed official examples cover supported rates, marginal relief, associated-company effects and short/long-period apportionment.
Tax-year boundary and rounding fixtures produce reproducible results without consulting a third-party calculation engine.

tasks.title: Prepare CT600 and every supplementary page required by the supported company cases
tasks.description: Prepare CT600 and every supplementary page required by the supported company cases. Make omitted cases clear before a business relies on the service; do not silently drop disclosures.
acceptance: CT600 and required supplementary pages are generated for every supported company case with traceable field mappings.
Missing disclosures or unsupported supplements block preparation; schema/period/amount validation rejects incomplete packages.

tasks.title: Produce statutory accounts for the agreed company types and accounting framework, including disclosures, prior-year comparisons and approval details
tasks.description: Produce statutory accounts for the agreed company types and accounting framework, including disclosures, prior-year comparisons and approval details. Reconcile them to the ledger and tax computation.
acceptance: Statutory accounts for approved company types/frameworks include disclosures, comparatives and approval details reconciled to ledger and tax computation.
Prior-year figures and amendments retain source lineage; incomplete framework/disclosure cases are explicit blockers rather than omitted pages.

tasks.title: Build and validate iXBRL accounts and computations against the applicable taxonomy and HMRC requirements
tasks.description: Build and validate iXBRL accounts and computations against the applicable taxonomy and HMRC requirements. Preserve tagging/version evidence and readable copies. This work is owned in-house.
acceptance: In-house iXBRL generation produces readable accounts/computation packages valid against applicable taxonomies and HMRC rules.
Tagging, context, precision and taxonomy-version tests reconcile figures to CT600/accounts and retain immutable package evidence.

tasks.title: Implement direct Corporation Tax submission, validation, receipts, rejection handling, amendments and recovery
tasks.description: Implement direct Corporation Tax submission, validation, receipts, rejection handling, amendments and recovery. Resolve the separate Companies House accounts-filing scope and requirements if promised.
acceptance: Direct Corporation Tax payload validation/submission/status/amendment adapters pass supported local/sandbox cases with receipt recovery.
Record whether Companies House accounts filing is promised and its distinct requirements; live credentials/submissions remain separately authorised.

tasks.title: Test full accounts-to-tax-to-filing packages, including period/rounding edge cases, with independent professional review
tasks.description: Test full accounts-to-tax-to-filing packages, including period/rounding edge cases, with independent professional review. Maintain rule, form and taxonomy updates after release.
acceptance: Independent professional review validates complete accounts-to-computation-to-filing packages including period and rounding edge cases.
Evidence records rule/form/taxonomy versions, amendments, rejected/unknown statuses and an ongoing update process for every supported case.

tasks.title: Connect a real extraction/OCR implementation for supported PDFs and photos
tasks.description: Connect a real extraction/OCR implementation for supported PDFs and photos; the current reviewed capture path still needs manual fields. Preserve originals, source hashes, tenant deduplication and provenance. No third-party tax/payroll engine is involved. Any external OCR data destination or provider connection must pass P14-04 and P14-82 before use.
acceptance: A real approved extraction implementation returns text/fields/evidence for representative PDF/PNG/JPEG inputs while retaining immutable source hash and provenance.
Unknown layouts and poor-quality sources preserve a manual route; output is an untrusted proposal and cannot post, choose authority or execute document instructions.

tasks.title: Run document parsing in isolated workers with page/size/time limits, malware controls and restricted permissions
tasks.description: Run document parsing in isolated workers with page/size/time limits, malware controls and restricted permissions. Handle encrypted, corrupted, malformed and unsupported files safely.
acceptance: Parser execution runs under restricted permissions with enforced byte/page/dimension/time/resource bounds and malware/quarantine handling.
Encrypted, corrupt, malicious and unsupported inputs cannot execute code, access other tenants or bypass timeout/cancellation; original files remain recoverable.

tasks.title: Complete field-evidence review: show supplier, dates, references, quantities, prices, VAT and totals beside the relevant source evidence
tasks.description: Complete field-evidence review: show supplier, dates, references, quantities, prices, VAT and totals beside the relevant source evidence. Add a safe source viewer to reduce download/context switching.
acceptance: Supplier/date/reference/line/price/VAT/total proposals display adjacent to verifiable source/page evidence and a safe supported viewer.
Evidence mismatches, unsupported previews and stale company/source changes clear unsafe content and preserve download/manual review; PDF preview is not claimed from the image-only trial slice.

tasks.title: Surface uncertain fields and total mismatches
tasks.description: Surface uncertain fields and total mismatches; make corrections invalidate stale reviews. Keep explicit human review before conversion and preserve the atomic source-to-native-draft transaction.
acceptance: Uncertain fields and total mismatches require explicit correction/review; any source/form change invalidates prior acknowledgement and review identity.
One confirmed source converts atomically to at most one native draft with audit; stale review, duplicate delivery and permission change cannot post or create duplicate drafts.

tasks.title: Persist extraction jobs and show queued, processing, failed, cancelled and retry states
tasks.description: Persist extraction jobs and show queued, processing, failed, cancelled and retry states. A failed worker must preserve the document and manual-entry route without creating a second draft.
acceptance: Queued/processing/failed/cancelled/retry states survive worker/API restart and are visible against the correct company/source.
Lease expiry, duplicate jobs and interrupted conversion retain the original file and manual route without a second draft or misleading success.

tasks.title: Test photos/PDFs of the same document, mixed VAT, credits, repeated descriptions and malicious instructions in documents
tasks.description: Test photos/PDFs of the same document, mixed VAT, credits, repeated descriptions and malicious instructions in documents. Measure extraction accuracy and time saved; do not count a proposal as posted accounting.
acceptance: Run the same synthetic photo/PDF/credit/mixed-VAT/repeated-description/malicious-instruction pack and record extraction errors plus manual re-entry time.
Compare accuracy and time against a measured manual baseline; verify proposals never count as posted documents or received credits.

tasks.title: Scoped and bounded PNG/JPEG source preview
tasks.description: Completed bounded slice integrated in 276760c and dimension-limited in 4e1eb5d: authenticated image preview with signature/size/dimension checks and abort/revoke cleanup. PDF preview and field evidence remain P12-03.
acceptance: Integrated tests enforce PNG/JPEG signature, size/dimension limits and supported-preview boundaries; PDF download remains available without claiming inline rendering.
Close/company/source switch and late responses abort/revoke image URLs and cannot expose stale-company content.

tasks.title: Suggest credit matches using supplier, original bill/line, amounts, quantities, remaining capacity and evidence
tasks.description: Suggest credit matches using supplier, original bill/line, amounts, quantities, remaining capacity and evidence. Require confirmation; a suggestion or draft never counts as a received credit.
acceptance: Suggestions compare supplier, original line, quantities, amount, remaining capacity and source evidence with explainable match reasons.
Wrong supplier/repeated part/partial credit/discount cases cannot auto-confirm; only explicit authorised confirmation updates received-credit state.

tasks.title: Finish partial, repeated and disputed return cases, credit receipt correction and customer-visible reasons for blocked actions, using the shared accounting rules from priorities 01 and 05
tasks.description: Finish partial, repeated and disputed return cases, credit receipt correction and customer-visible reasons for blocked actions, using the shared accounting rules from priorities 01 and 05.

Blocked operations explain their actual reason and allow safe next actions without removing credit/correction/tenant protections.

tasks.title: Keep return, part, job and supplier references without retyping them
tasks.description: Keep return, part, job and supplier references without retyping them. Make expected/received/remaining values and source links understandable in the queue, original bill and reports.

Expected, received and remaining values reconcile with the confirmed source/journal after partial credit, correction and refund.

tasks.title: Add prioritisation, ageing and follow-up visibility for unresolved credits
tasks.description: Add prioritisation, ageing and follow-up visibility for unresolved credits. Define any reminder-sending workflow and its explicit user controls before enabling it.
acceptance: Unresolved claims expose priority, age, follow-up state and source context without changing accounting balances.
Any reminder path requires a reviewable recipient/content/action and permission check; this task prepares drafts only and external sending is P14-81.

tasks.title: Connect the chosen bank-feed route after native statement import/matching is reliable
tasks.description: Connect the chosen bank-feed route after native statement import/matching is reliable. Fixture/sandbox tests cover renewal, revocation, replay, duplicates and disconnect-with-evidence; production connection is gated by P14-80.

tasks.title: Build authorised email intake with message/attachment identity, provenance and safe attachment handling
tasks.description: Build authorised email intake with message/attachment identity, provenance and safe attachment handling. Handle forwarding, replay and the same document arriving by email and upload.
acceptance: Authorised intake validates authenticated delivery and stable message/attachment identity with provenance and safe attachment processing.
Forwarding, replay, spoofed hints, revoked access and the same file arriving by upload/email cannot duplicate a draft or broaden mailbox access; live connection is P14-80.

tasks.title: Complete reliable document/payslip delivery where promised: secure templates, correct recipients, retry/delivery status and audit
tasks.description: Complete reliable document/payslip delivery where promised: secure templates, correct recipients, retry/delivery status and audit. Distinguish queued, sent and failed messages; protect confidential payroll content.

Queued, attempted, confirmed-sent and failed statuses are distinct; retries do not double-send and no real message is sent without P14-81.

tasks.title: Define retention, permissions and data destinations for every connected service
tasks.description: Define retention, permissions and data destinations for every connected service. Test token expiry, outages and manual fallback without losing work or silently broadening access.

Contract tests cover expired credentials, outages and manual fallback without data loss or expanded access; unknown services/destinations fail closed.

tasks.title: Authorise live bank or mailbox connection
tasks.description: Approve each concrete bank-feed/mailbox account and consent scope before the implemented adapter connects to it.
acceptance: Owner verifies the selected bank/mail account, purpose, data scope and retention before connecting.
Connection and disconnect/revocation are audited; existing financial records are not posted/reconciled merely because a service is connected.

tasks.title: Authorise actual external document or reminder sending
tasks.description: A real recipient-directed send requires explicit instruction identifying the recipient and message/document. Preparation, testing and drafts remain approved without this gate.
acceptance: Record verified recipient, reviewed content/attachment and action-specific authority before a real send.
Store verified delivery outcome and replay identity; do not report queued/failed/unknown as sent or transmit payroll to an unverified recipient.

tasks.title: Authorise any external extraction service data destination
tasks.description: If OCR/extraction uses an external service, approve the specific connection and allowed data destination first; a local engine does not require this external action.

No user document is transmitted before the applicable permission is present, and failure preserves the manual entry route.

tasks.title: Verify phone, desktop, keyboard and screen-reader journeys, labels/focus, long documents and readable contrast
tasks.description: Verify phone, desktop, keyboard and screen-reader journeys, labels/focus, long documents and readable contrast. Complete empty/loading/error/permission states and recovery from failed actions.

Empty/loading/error/permission cases expose useful recovery and do not hide financial evidence or trap keyboard focus.

tasks.title: Test company switching and stale responses across every page and export
tasks.description: Test company switching and stale responses across every page and export; retain period, filter and document context through report drilldowns.

Report/account/document/journal navigation retains approved filters and scope, and fresh reads recover after stale requests are cancelled.

tasks.title: Reduce the large frontend entry bundle with measured route/export loading improvements
tasks.description: Reduce the large frontend entry bundle with measured route/export loading improvements; benchmark real navigation and large ledgers. Sign-in, deep links, company switch, export, failed chunk retry and remount tests pass; no percentage improvement is inferred solely from agent count.

tasks.title: Reject stale BankTransactions list and suggestion responses
tasks.description: Completed bounded fix integrated in 04ac5b6: company-keyed bank workspace, generation-fenced list/suggestion reads and action-result callbacks. Verified in the combined 648-test source suite and full workspace build/typecheck; wider journey qualification remains open.

tasks.title: Lazy workspace route loading and retry recovery

Build evidence records entry/chunk changes; no real-user latency or large-ledger performance claim is inferred from bundle size alone.

tasks.title: Complete the production deployment pipeline, reviewed schema rollout, environment separation and release rollback
tasks.description: Complete the production deployment pipeline, reviewed schema rollout, environment separation and release rollback. Verify the deployed commit, configuration and schema match the qualified build.

Disposable/staging rollout and rollback rehearsals verify compatibility and fail closed on missing checks; production deployment is a separate P18-80 action.

tasks.title: Add actionable monitoring for errors, financial mismatches, job backlog, filing failures, access events and capacity
tasks.description: Add actionable monitoring for errors, financial mismatches, job backlog, filing failures, access events and capacity; redact sensitive diagnostics and assign alert/incident ownership.
acceptance: Instrument request errors, financial reconciliation anomalies, job lag, filing failures, access events and capacity with actionable redacted identifiers.
Synthetic incidents trigger the assigned alert/runbook path while tests prove logs exclude tokens, personal pay/tax data and raw document content.

tasks.title: Test realistic volumes, concurrent users, large imports and exports, slow/downstream outages and worker restarts
tasks.description: Test realistic volumes, concurrent users, large imports and exports, slow/downstream outages and worker restarts. Set capacity limits and avoid queues that grow without bounds.
acceptance: Run bounded synthetic concurrent-user/import/export/large-ledger tests and record latency, memory, queue growth and configured limits.
Slow/downstream outages and worker restarts demonstrate bounded retries/backpressure and recovery with no duplicate financial effects.

tasks.title: Rehearse off-site recovery to a new environment against the agreed recovery targets, including files, keys, roles and background work
tasks.description: Rehearse off-site recovery to a new environment against the agreed recovery targets, including files, keys, roles and background work. The disposable database drill alone does not close this gate.

Compare source/restored fingerprints, permissions and measured recovery targets; leave the source and all customer environments unchanged.

tasks.title: Complete independent security assessment, remediation and incident/support runbooks
tasks.description: Complete independent security assessment, remediation and incident/support runbooks. Exercise a failed deployment, a lost response and a data-recovery incident before customer release.

Exercise failed release, unknown financial response and disaster recovery using synthetic data with recorded incident ownership and support steps.

tasks.title: Finish signup, invitations, subscription/billing, plan entitlements and cancellation
tasks.description: Finish signup, invitations, subscription/billing, plan entitlements and cancellation; define what users can still view/export after suspension. Test account lifecycle without deleting accounting evidence accidentally.
acceptance: Signup, invites, entitlements, suspension/cancellation and export access are exercised against sandbox billing fixtures.
Retries and account transitions cannot erase retained accounting evidence or grant unpaid/unauthorised access; live billing account/purchase configuration remains P17-80.

tasks.title: Set pricing, supported customer profile and accurate feature claims
tasks.description: Set pricing, supported customer profile and accurate feature claims. Complete launch website/domain, help content, onboarding examples and a clear route to human support.

Validate onboarding/support paths and remove unsupported compliance/automation claims; publishing, domain purchase and live pricing approval remain separate owner actions.

tasks.title: Complete privacy/terms, processor arrangements, retention/deletion/export policy and appropriate customer consent with qualified review
tasks.description: Complete privacy/terms, processor arrangements, retention/deletion/export policy and appropriate customer consent with qualified review. Align these documents with actual data flows and backup behaviour.
acceptance: Draft and obtain qualified review of privacy/terms/processor/retention/deletion/export requirements against the actual data-flow inventory.
Test retention/export consent behavior and backup implications; no contract is signed or new processor connected by preparing these documents.

tasks.title: Assign customer support, tax/payroll rule maintenance and incident cover
tasks.description: Assign customer support, tax/payroll rule maintenance and incident cover; document response targets and escalation. Train support on failed filings, disputed balances and safe recovery.

Rehearse support handling of rejected/unknown filing, disputed balance and safe recovery using synthetic cases; record unresolved coverage gaps.

tasks.title: Approve live billing, commercial terms and purchases
tasks.description: Owner reviews concrete pricing/terms and any live billing account, domain purchase or other charge before external activation; code and draft assets remain independently actionable.
acceptance: Record the exact offer, terms, account/domain/purchase and cost approved by the owner.
Do not charge customers, accept binding terms, publish assets or buy services without the required specific approval.

tasks.title: Run the complete journey pack on the exact integrated build: import/setup, source-to-draft, post, pay, credit, correct, reconcile, report, tax/file, payroll, close and export
tasks.description: Run the complete journey pack on the exact integrated build: import/setup, source-to-draft, post, pay, credit, correct, reconcile, report, tax/file, payroll, close and export.
acceptance: Run import/setup, source-to-draft, posting, payment, credit, correction, reconciliation, reporting, tax filing simulation, payroll, close and export on one exact integrated build.
Each supported journey records source/commit/rule/schema evidence, reconciled outcomes and recovery checks; no test writes production or submits a live return.

tasks.title: Use a supervised pilot with clearly declared supported cases, real usability feedback and reconciled outcomes
tasks.description: Use a supervised pilot with clearly declared supported cases, real usability feedback and reconciled outcomes. Fix issues and rerun affected journeys; do not treat a narrow pilot as completion of the full product.
acceptance: Within the separately authorised pilot scope, collect reconciled outcomes and observed usability feedback with declared supported boundaries.
Fix pilot defects and rerun affected integrated journeys; pilot scope does not remove any agreed commercial accounting/tax/payroll functionality.

tasks.title: Require evidence for all promised accounting, tax and payroll cases, permissions, recovery and operations
tasks.description: Require evidence for all promised accounting, tax and payroll cases, permissions, recovery and operations. Independently review calculations and the user-facing results, not just the code.
acceptance: Independent accounting/payroll/security reviewers examine the user-facing results and evidence for every supported product and operational case.
Open blockers, excluded cases and review limitations are explicit; passing a component/unit suite cannot substitute for integrated acceptance.

tasks.title: Record the final release decision, known supported boundaries, exact version/migrations, monitoring and support ownership
tasks.description: Record the final release decision, known supported boundaries, exact version/migrations, monitoring and support ownership. Resolve release blockers before opening self-service commercial use.
acceptance: Prepare a concrete release decision package containing exact commit/migrations/configuration, supported boundaries, resolved blockers and review evidence.
Monitoring, recovery and support ownership are confirmed; self-service release remains disabled until the action-specific P18-80 approval.

tasks.title: Authorise and execute commercial production release
tasks.description: After the concrete release decision package passes, obtain explicit production deployment/publishing authority for the exact version and environment.
acceptance: Record exact approved commit, migrations, target, release window, recovery plan and accountable owner before production changes.
Verify deployed version/schema/configuration, monitoring and rollback readiness; do not force-push, bypass checks or deploy an unapproved version.

tasks.title: Authorise the concrete supervised pilot
tasks.description: Prepare and approve pilot participants, supported cases, environment, data permissions and support before admitting real users or real financial records.
acceptance: Owner approves a reviewable participant/data/environment scope with declared boundaries and support ownership.
Pilot setup preserves production protections and does not authorise live filing, money movement or reduced commercial scope.
